region: South Bay, Los Angeles County, California

needs.need: The city hires far more people than it houses
needs.next_step: Count who commutes in and from where, then test what would let more of them live or stay nearby: shuttles from the Metro stations, housing near the job centers, evening reasons to stay.
Map the routes into aerospace that do not start with an engineering degree: harness, composites and test technician roles at the same employers, and where the training for them is taught.

needs.need: Almost nothing posted for care, teaching or food
needs.next_step: Ask directly. A short survey of schools, clinics, care homes and restaurants would settle whether this is a real shortage or a blind spot in the data.
